_comment: Helpline details need verification before public release.

rounds.worry: Someone at school keeps hurting me on purpose and I do not know who to tell.
options: Keep it secret forever
Tell a class teacher or school counsellor
Reply angrily to the bully
Post about it online
rounds.explain: A teacher or school counsellor can act on bullying. Telling a trusted adult is the right first step.

rounds.worry: Someone is hurt or in danger right now.
options: Wait and see if it passes
Call 112 and tell a grown-up near you
Send a message to a friend
Take a photo for later
rounds.explain: 112 is the single emergency number in India. Get help from people nearby straight away.

rounds.worry: I feel unsafe at home and need someone to talk to, any time of day.
options: CHILDLINE 1098 (free, 24 hours)
Post about it on social media
Wait until tomorrow
Ask an online stranger for advice
rounds.explain: CHILDLINE 1098 is a free, 24-hour helpline for children in India who need care, protection, or someone to talk to.

rounds.worry: An unknown adult online asked me to keep our chats a secret.
options: Keep chatting, it is a secret
Stop replying, keep the messages, and tell a parent or trusted adult
Send them a photo to be friendly
Delete everything and say nothing
rounds.explain: Stop replying, keep the messages as evidence, and tell a trusted adult. Do not delete them.

rounds.worry: A profile that looks like a game account asks me to send money or share a code to claim a prize.
options: Share the code quickly
Ask the profile to prove it is real
Stop replying, save the messages, and tell a trusted adult who can call 1930
Send the profile to every friend
rounds.explain: A trusted adult can help with a fake profile or online fraud. India’s cybercrime helpline is 1930.

rounds.worry: I have felt very sad or stressed for many days and it is hard to enjoy my usual activities.
options: Keep it to myself forever
Try to handle it alone
Wait without telling anyone
Tell a trusted adult and ask them to contact Tele-MANAS 14416
rounds.explain: You deserve support when feelings are heavy for a long time. A trusted adult can listen and can help contact Tele-MANAS at 14416.

rounds.worry: I see another child being made to work instead of attending school.
options: Tell a trusted adult or contact CHILDLINE 1098
Make fun of the child
Ignore it
Put myself in danger to fix it alone
rounds.explain: Children need time to learn and grow. Tell a trusted adult; CHILDLINE 1098 can also help children who need support.

rounds.worry: A child is told they cannot be admitted to school.
options: Give up on school
Talk to a parent or teacher, and ask CHILDLINE 1098 for help if needed
Keep it secret
Blame the child
rounds.explain: Every child deserves a chance to learn. A parent, teacher, or trusted adult can help, and CHILDLINE 1098 can support children who need help.
